title: Battle of Pucacasa
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Pucacasa", at revision 1370586703, opens: "The Battle of Pucacasa took place between 22 and 23 March, 1781, in the Quispicanchi province of Cusco, between Spanish royalists led by José del Valle, and Túpac Amaru II's rebel army. It was the first major engagement between the Spanish reinforcements from Lima and Túpac Amaru's main army. Both sides suffered heavy losses, with Del Valle narrowly retreating the area." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q11688225, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1781 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
